description: This file defines the HomeFragment class in an Android app, implementing the main home screen UI for a streaming service. It includes setup for a brand label, top navigation bar, and content rails with mock data, optimized for TV navigation (D-pad focus). It also contains internal models, mock data generators, and UI configuration code.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment representing the home screen, setting up branding, navigation, and content sections with focus handling for Android TV.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data model representing individual content cards in the UI.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data model representing a row of content items, e.g., 'Recommended for You'.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Object providing mock data for content items, simulating network or database data for UI display.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout, initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up UI components: brand label, top navigation bar, and content rails.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Creates a styled SpannableString for the brand label with a specific segment colored differently.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the horizontal top navigation RecyclerView with a special search item and boundary focus handling.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Creates mock content rows with items and initializes vertical RecyclerView for content display.
